notes.title: September 16: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Stylists,

■ September 14, 2025 Updates

★ Optimizations ★

● Reduced harvest requirements for unlocking Targeted Cultivation in the Planting ability.

● Increased fish yields of Home-specific fish at all levels/proficiency tiers in the Fish Keeping ability.

● Boosted weight bonuses and surprise harvest chances from fish food at all levels in Fish Keeping.

● New reward tiers added to \[Home Abilities > Ability Level Evaluation], including \[Astralites] and \[Budget Increase].

● Improved performance in \[Starstring Melody] and \[Kitty Dance Machine].

★ Fixed Issues ★

● Fixed an issue where multiple Nikki models appeared when viewing schemes in the \[Color Lookbook] under certain conditions.

● Fixed an issue where players fell abnormally in Home under certain conditions.

● Fixed an issue where Nikki's poses glitched during photography under certain conditions.

● Fixed an issue where chair-related furniture interactions behaved erratically.

notes.title: September 1: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Stylists,



In order to provide a better gaming experience, we've recently implemented optimizations, adjustments, and bug fixes to the game. Thank you for your understanding and support. We wish you a pleasant journey in Miraland!



★Fixed Issues & Optimizations★

■ September 1, 2025 Updates

★Optimizations★

■ General

● Enhanced display effects for unclaimed key rewards in the \[Deep Echoes] interface.

● Streamlined the level selection process for \[Mira Crown]. After a new phase of \[Mira Crown Pinnacle Contest] begins, stylists who earned specific star ratings in the previous phase of \[Mira Crown Pinnacle Contest] can now skip preliminary rounds. Skipped rounds are auto-completed at three stars, granting immediate rewards.

● Added confirmation pop-ups when exchanging more than 10 items in the \[Resonance] or \[Diamond] section of the Store, showing quantity and results.

● New camera settings under \[Settings > Controls]: \[Camera Distance] for adjusting Nikki's proximity in the open world and \[Field of View] for expanding/reducing visible area.

● Improved photo management: Photos can be deleted right after capture.

● Added \[Prolonged Presence] for the \[Default: Roaming Loong] ability of the \[Clouded Loong] outfit: When enabled, the White Loong lingers for 10 seconds after dismissal. If entering photo mode during this window, the Loong persists throughout the shoot.



■ Graphics & Display

● Added a display device switcher, allowing stylists with multi-monitor setups to seamlessly select which screen runs the game.

● Added support for Intel XeSS Super Resolution and Frame Generation.



■ Co-op Gameplay

● Optimized the performance of various game functions when Stylists are present in public co-op areas such as \[the Sea of Stars].

※ \[Mira Crown], \[Styling Factions], \[Realm Challenge], and \[Folklore Guide] can be accessed without having to leave the co-op area.

※ When in these public co-op areas, tracked solo quests will display corresponding zone-specific hints.

● Stylists can now view solo quest summaries during open-world co-op. Additionally, when in co-op mode, a quick exit co-op shortcut has been added to solo quest detail interfaces.

● Optimized the presentation of open-world co-op invitations, adding a waiting status icon for invitations on the main interface.

● Optimized error messages for co-op invitations, enabling stylists to view failure reasons more clearly when initiating co-op.

● Optimized two-player hand holding performance, improving smoothness and motion effects.



■ Color Lookbook & DIY Workshop

● Optimized the experience of viewing and saving outfit/Dyeing Schemes in the \[Color Lookbook]. After importing and saving a Dyeing Scheme, stylists can choose to jump to the Wardrobe interface and immediately equip the imported scheme.

● Added a button to restore default colors in the \[DIY Workshop] dye interface. Using it removes all applied Dyeing Schemes from currently worn clothing items. Using it again reapplies the removed schemes.

● Optimized the visual indicators displaying outfit pieces' compatibility with Dye effects, Patterns, and Special Effects.

● Optimized warning text during Dyeing Scheme imports for unobtained clothing items and locked palettes.

● Added an unlock function for all available color palettes of the current outfit piece in the palette interface.



★Fixed Issues★

● Fixed an issue where dye effects failed to take effect when switching the \[Snow Script] piece of the \[Clouded Loong] outfit from handheld to worn state.

● Fixed an issue where switching between alternate details of the \[Clouded Loong] outfit overwrote saved Dyeing Scheme for the long style.

● Fixed an issue where arm animations glitched on the \[Earthly Blessing] piece of the \[Gossamer Moonfairy] outfit during the \[Scroll of Splendor: Purification] ability.

● Fixed an issue where Area 2 couldn't be dyed after glowing up the \[Rosecrown Dance] piece of the \[Pink Ribbon Waltz] outfit.

● Fixed an issue where dye effects didn't take effect on the \[Graceful Branch] piece of the \[Misty Poetics] outfit when first entering the open world.

● Fixed an issue where Fireworks order sequences displayed incorrectly after reordering in the \[Fireworks Crafting Station].

● Fixed an issue where players floated uncontrollably when activating the camera while transformed into a Blushbunny in Animal Playtime.

● Fixed an issue where patterns appeared blurry on the \[Searching for Light] piece of the outfit \[Spectral Mist] on certain device models.

● Fixed an issue where NPC Liu Cangxia's hair disappeared in \[Danqing Island] on certain device models.

● Fixed an issue where dye effects malfunctioned in the open world for certain pieces of the \[Blooming Dreams] outfit under certain conditions.

● Fixed an issue where dye effects malfunctioned in the open world for certain pieces of the \[Timeless Melody] outfit under certain conditions.

● Fixed an issue where dye effects malfunctioned in the open world for the \[Emerald Lake] outfit piece under certain conditions.

● Fixed an issue where visual anomalies occurred on pieces of the \[Crimson Rhapsody] outfit under certain conditions.

● Fixed an issue where visual anomalies occurred on the \[Graceful Departure] piece under certain conditions.

● Fixed an issue where the two characters didn't return to starting positions after canceling the Loong ride under certain conditions.

● Fixed an issue where dye effects malfunctioned in the open world for certain pieces of the \[Crimson Feather] outfit under certain conditions.

Dear Stylists, 

In order to provide a better gaming experience, we've recently implemented optimizations, adjustments, and bug fixes to the game. Thank you for your understanding and support. We wish you a pleasant journey in Miraland!

■ July 29, 2025 Updates

★ Optimizations ★

■ \[Sea of Stars] Navigation Improvements

● Reduced difficulty for the following quests in \[Starlit Moments]: \[Echoes From the Star Sea], \[Harvest Joy], and \[Starwish Delivery], where the required objectives decreased from 20 to 10.

notes.title: Infinity Nikki is getting a big update this week, but will that be enough to turn its Steam review rating around?
notes.notes: Infinity Nikki, the visually impressive, open-world dress-up game that came out late last year, continues to grow with new updates. The game's latest, arriving this Friday, June 13, is one of its biggest, kicking off a new seasonal chapter. Read more

notes.title: June 12: Version 1.6 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Dear Stylists,



Infinity Nikki will undergo a version update from 12:50 to 20:00 on June 12, 2025 (UTC-7). During this period, the game will be inaccessible. Please plan ahead to avoid any unnecessary losses.

The maintenance schedule may be adjusted based on actual conditions. Details of this update can be found below. We appreciate your understanding and support!

※The limited-time Resonance events "Eternal Snow," "Unfading Heart," "Whispering Stream," "Harvest Dream," and "Croaker's Whisper" will end at 12: 49 :59 on June 12 (UTC-7). Please remember to claim your rewards in [Deep Echoes] in time.

※The events "Chase the Bubbles!", "Rainbow Album," "Where Are the Gifties?", "Floating Bubbles," "Rainbow and Pattern," "Adventure Together," "Cozy Caretakers: Protect the Pandas," "Alison's Travel Shop," and "Journey Through Serenity" will end at 12: 49 :59 on June 12 (UTC-7).

※The "Bubble Market" and "Heartfelt Gifts" will close at 12: 49 :59 on June 12 (UTC-7). The following outfits will also be made unavailable at 12: 49 :59 on June 12 (UTC-7): [Bubble's Hometown] in "Bubble Gratitude," [Graceful Elegance], [Midnight Vogue], and [Heartfelt Melody] in "Clothing."



★ Maintenance Duration ★

June 12, 12:50 to 20:00 (UTC-7)



★ Compensation ★

Diamond*300, Resonite Crystal*1

*Available only to stylists who log in and unlock the inbox feature before 08:59 on June 20, 2025 (UTC-7).



★ New Content ★

■ The limited-time Exclusive Quest "Only the Fairies Know" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

How to participate: Complete the Main Quest "Power Outage Rescue" to unlock.

Description: Complete the "Only the Fairies Know" Exclusive Quest to earn rewards such as [Diamonds] and [Sketch: Born for Miracles], [growth materials], and more.

■ The "Fun to Play" event unlocks.

● The limited-time World & Random Quest series "Cherubic Moments" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

How to participate: Complete the Main Quest "Power Outage Rescue" to unlock.

Description: Complete World Quests in "Playful Adventures" and Random Quests in "Playful Chatter" to obtain [Diamonds], [Title: Guardian of Innocence], [growth materials], and more.

● The limited-time event "Finding the Slumbering Animals" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

How to participate: Complete the Exclusive Quest "Only the Fairies Know" to unlock.

Stylists can choose to play through the levels in solo mode or co-op mode to obtain [Diamonds], [Card: Cuckoo Baa-Baa Rhapsody], [growth materials], and more.

● The limited-time gameplay feature "Windsong Tunnel" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

How to participate: Complete the Main Quest "Power Outage Rescue" to unlock.

Description: Visit [Stoneville] to experience the magical tunnel that makes animals fly and exchange with "Amos" for special "Sky Dust" (usable in the tunnel), while obtaining [Diamonds] through gameplay.

● The limited-time gameplay feature "Thuddy Squash Spin" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

How to participate: Complete the Main Quest "Power Outage Rescue" to unlock.

Description: Go to [Stoneville] and talk to "Leonie" to try it out, while obtaining [Diamonds] by through gameplay.

● The limited-time gameplay feature "Hop on the Beretsant" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

How to participate: Complete the Main Quest "Power Outage Rescue" to unlock.

Description: Go to [Stoneville] and interact with the "Giant Beretsant" to obtain [Diamonds].

■ The "Time to Collect" event unlocks.

● The limited-time event "Playful Hearts Album" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

How to participate: Complete the Main Quest "Power Outage Rescue" to unlock.

Description: Fill the "Playful Hearts Album" to obtain [Diamonds], [Upgrade Packs], and more.

● The limited-time event "Where Are the Gifties?" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

How to participate: Complete the Main Quest "Power Outage Rescue" to unlock.

Description: During the event, help track down the stray Gifties and ensure their safe return to Gifty Island to earn [Diamonds], [growth materials], and more.

● The limited-time event "Veiled in Verses" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

How to participate: Complete the Main Quest "Power Outage Rescue" to unlock.

Description: During the event, 4 tasks will be unlocked at a time. Complete these tasks to earn "Folded Poems." Once you collect the required amount of "Folded Poems," you can exchange for the three-star outfit [Misty Poetics], [Diamonds], [growth materials], and more.

■ The limited-time check-in event "Together in Playful Moments" unlocks.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – June 23, 18:59 (UTC-7)

Description: Log in for a total of 7 days to claim [Revelation Crystal]*10.

■ "Fairy's Secret" limited-time Resonance starts.

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

Description: Stylists can head over to Resonance and obtain the new 5-star outfit [Enchanted Encounter] and 4-star outfit [Twilight Oath].

>> Complete the 5-star outfit [Enchanted Encounter] to unlock the following ability:

[Fairy: Animal-Grooming]: As Nikki taps her wand softly after using the ability, shimmering starlight spills into the air. In the glow, animals gently rise, shedding their dust as they transform into fairies with fluttering wings.

>> Complete the 4-star outfit [Twilight Oath] to unlock the following ability:

[Prince Bow: Whimsicality]: After using the ability, Nikki will bow gracefully, and in that fleeting moment, starlight and blossoms swirl together, blooming into a dazzling display of elegance.

>> Resonance Milestone Reward

Upon reaching 160 Resonance attempts in "Fairy's Secret," the decoration [Fairy Traces] can be claimed. Place it in open spaces for photo shooting or as decoration. The effect is shown in the image below.

■ The limited-time event "Starlit Pursuit" unlocks.

Duration: June 15, 13:00 – July 6, 12:59 (UTC-7)

Description: Every week, venture to designated locations to search for Starlight. Collect [Starlit Crystals] to claim blessings from the stars and exchange them for exclusive items at the "Starlit Shop."

■ Mira Journey: New Phase

Duration: June 12 (After Server Launch) – July 7, 12:49 (UTC-7)

Description: When [Mira Journey] begins, [Journey Overture] will automatically unlock. Complete [Journey Tasks] to earn Journey EXP, level up, and receive rewards like Resonite Crystals and Energy Crystals.

>>By purchasing and unlocking [Distant Anthem], Diamond *680 will be given instantly, with an additional Diamond *680, Revelation Crystals, and [Momo's Cloak: Dreamland] available through leveling.

>>By purchasing and unlocking [Miracle Epic], all current [Distant Anthem] level rewards will be unlocked plus a 10-level boost. Additionally, rewards like Stellarites, an Avatar Frame, and Energy Crystals will also be given.

■ [Store] Various Items Available

● New Arrivals in "Magical Playhouse"

From June 12 after server launch until July 7 at 12:49 (UTC-7), go to "Store: Magical Playhouse" for exclusive offers:

>>[Sweetdream Cauldron]

Spend only 300 Stellarites to get the decoration [Stirring Sweet Dreams].

>>[Mischief Managed]

Snag the charming set [Fun and Frolic] for only 180 Stellarites, which includes [Hair: Bedhead Chic], [Pose: Gentle Wipe], and [Playful Art: Makeup].

>>[Childhood Dream]

Spend only 180 Diamonds to get the new decoration [Sleepless Spin].

● New Arrivals in [Store: Clothing]

From June 12 after server launch until July 7 at 12:49 (UTC-7), the following outfits will be available for a limited time in [Store: Clothing]: [Among Bamboo Shadows] and [Sky Supplier].

● Featured Packs Update

From June 12 after server launch until July 7 at 12:49 (UTC-7), go to [Store: Featured] to purchase the "Innocent Resonance Pack Series" and the Playful Season exclusive "Timeflow Prism Packs."

■ New Arrivals in the Starlit Shop

>>"Limited-Time"

From June 12 after server launch until July 7 at 12:49 (UTC-7), the following items will be added to [Starlit Shop: Limited-Time]: the five-star face decoration [Inspiration Overload], outfits including the four-star dresses [Streamside Adventure] and [Floral Murmurs], poses including [Heartfelt Sync] and [Playful Dance]. Stylists can use [Starlit Crystals] to exchange for them.

>>"Permanent"

After server launch on June 12, the poses [Blush & Hide] and [Snuggle Snuggle] will be added to "Starlit Shop: Permanent." Stylists can use [Starlit Crystals] to exchange for them.

■ Update: Mira Crown Pinnacle Contest

Event Duration: June 16, 2025, 4:00 – July 1, 2025, 3:59 (Server Time)

Effects: +50% to Eurekas.

■ [Riding Styling] Enabled

● Enabled outfit customization when riding. After the update, you can now change outfits in the Wardrobe interface while riding. Riding outfits do not affect your standard styling schemes.

■ [Eureka] Recycling Enabled

● A new Recycle function has been added for Eurekas. Recycling a Eureka grants equivalent EXP to what it provides as upgrade material. This EXP is directly converted into Shining Particles, which can be used to upgrade other Eurekas.
